result.final_text:
## What this letter says
This letter is about your scan at Eastmoor Maternity Unit.
It is your 20-week scan (anomaly scan).
The scan checks how your baby is growing.
It also looks for some physical conditions.
The scan cannot find every problem.

## What you need to do
1. Come to your scan on Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15.
2. Would an interpreter help you? Then call at least 5 working days before your appointment. The unit will book one for free.
3. The letter does not give a phone number for booking an interpreter. The only number in the letter is for the Maternity Assessment Unit.
4. You do not need a full bladder for this scan.
5. You may bring one adult with you.
6. Children cannot come into the scan room.

## Dates and medicines
- Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15: your 20-week scan (anomaly scan). It is in the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
- The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What number do I call to book an interpreter?
- What happens after the scan?
- When will I get the results of my scan?

## When to get urgent help
Do you have any of these before your appointment?
- any bleeding
- fluid leaking from your vagina
- severe (very bad) tummy pain

If so, call the Maternity Assessment Unit (MAU) straight away. The number is 01632 960 456. This line is open 24 hours.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
